survey: Image 5 is a DJ setup on an orange surface, seen from above at an angle. The controller is one blue unit made of three joined sections. Left deck: a small red display and colour pads at the back left, a large grey jog wheel in the middle, and a row of yellow and green pads along the front edge. Centre mixer: a raised light-blue screen at the back, a row of knobs, and three fader slots with fader caps sitting in them. Right deck: the same parts as the left deck (display, pads, jog wheel, front pad row), arranged slightly differently. The whole unit sits flat on a darker base plinth that touches the floor and casts a shadow. In front and to the right, a pair of over-ear headphones lies on the surface. One padded headband arcs between two ear cups. The left cup is turned so its cushion faces the camera, and the right cup shows its outer shell. Each cup joins the band through a short slider or yoke. Both cups and the band rest on the floor with contact shadows.
